target: Design a deployable workflow for preference learning using a pairwise preference dataset audit. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.

competency.title: Design preference learning — field data
competency.outcome: Design a deployable workflow for preference learning using a pairwise preference dataset audit. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: treating style preference as factual truth

competency.practice_task: Produce a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget grounded in a pairwise preference dataset audit.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.
required_evidence: a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget
Include the data card, missingness check and permitted use.
Report annotator agreement and ranking generalization with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: treating style preference as factual truth.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of preference learning.
Practice: an independent reviewer can execute its acceptance tests.
Measurement: report annotator agreement and ranking generalization against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for treating style preference as factual truth; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
